# Monthly Financial Recap

In this 28-day period, total income reached $58,860.00 against total spend of $48,147.25, generating a net cash flow surplus of $10,712.75. Utilities comprised the largest spending category at $24,609.00 (51.1% of spend), followed by Shopping at $19,801.80 (41.1%). The remaining 8.0% was split between Other and Dining. Income concentration is notable: the top client, Greenfield Estate Project, accounted for 21.2% of income, while the top three clients together represented 48.6% of the $58,860.00 total across ten income sources.
